from fastapi import FastAPI
import pickle

app = FastAPI()

@app.post("/upload_resume")
async def upload_resume(resume: bytes = FastAPI.Body(...)):
    resume_data = pickle.loads(resume)


    return resume_data

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import uvicorn
    uvicorn.run(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=8000)
